name: ProgressRing
description: A small ring that fills clockwise from 12 o'clock over a faint track: how full something is, at a glance.
usage: Use for a bounded amount (context used, quota, storage), not for loading: no indeterminate state
xs (14px) sits inline with status glyphs; sm 20px, md 32px, lg 48px
Switch tone to caution or danger at your own thresholds
examples: <ProgressRing value={137} max={500} size="xs" label="PM context" aria-valuetext="137k of 500k" />
design: 16-unit viewBox, r=6, stroke never scales (1.5px at xs, 2/3/4px above)
Track border-default; arc in the tone colour with a round cap; no arc at 0
Arc length transitions over --duration-travel, instant under reduced motion
accessibility: decorative hides it (aria-hidden) when the value is said elsewhere

props.name: tone
props.description: default draws in text-muted; caution and danger in the caution-fg and error-fg action tokens

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: How a screen reader reads the value, e.g. "372k of 500k"; defaults to the percentage
